name: Adventures of Norman the Cat
summary:
A tiny kitten. A big adventure. A lifetime of stories.

If you like cats, cute, random and/or weird games, continue reading...

Adventures of Norman the Cat is a quirky adventure inspired by the true story of a lucky kitten and the remarkable journey that followed.

Play as Norman, a curious ball of fluff navigating a world where the ordinary and the absurd happily coexist. Explore hand-crafted levels filled with unexpected encounters, strange characters, hidden secrets, and plenty of feline mischief. From humble beginnings to becoming the magnificent cat he was always destined to be, every step of Norman's journey reveals a new chapter in his life.

Featuring a playful mix of art styles, cheeky humour, and heartwarming storytelling, celebrating the small moments, big discoveries, and unlikely adventures that shape us all.

Whether you're chasing mysterious objects, investigating bizarre situations, or simply enjoying life through the eyes of a kitten, Norman's world is full of surprises waiting around every corner.

Things might look basic to start... but keep going!

Inspired by IRL Norman
